release_notes:
fix(orders): URL-encode redirect messages to prevent blank screen

The order-result redirect embedded the message straight into a
single-quoted JS string (window.location.href='...&msge=<msg>'). Language
strings such as the English insufficient-credits message ("You don't
have sufficient credits...") contain an apostrophe, which broke the JS
string so the redirect never fired and the user got a blank page. Wrap
every msge value in rawurlencode() so quotes/spaces/specials are safe;
the receiving page still decodes and displays it correctly.

(cherry picked from commit d39bc8df4ec134fda457c056751f7e9b0250df27)
